title: Polynomial Bound on Plan Work
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, let a finite CSP template over $D$ have a finite family of predicates with specified arities, and let an input consist of a CSP instance on $n$ variables and a randomized assignment. The work of its conditional-expectation plan is at most $|D|\bigl(|D|^{r}+1\bigr)(n+m)^2$, where $r$ is the maximum predicate arity and $m$ is the number of constraint occurrences.
hypotheses_covered: Finite predicate family and predicate arities
CSP input with variable count, instance, and randomized assignment
